content_html: Agent Memory Challenge 2026 Cycle 2 is now open. Long-term memory is not just about storing more history. It is about retrieving the right evidence, recognizing what has changed, and avoiding stale context when an agent needs to act. Three tracks: Textual · Coding · Multimodal Open-source Methods · Commercial Products Over USD 22,000 prize pool for eligible open-source teams. A shared Add/Search interface. Standardized Answer/Eval. Public, comparable results. Join: agentmemoryleaderboard.ai/evaluation
